name: Uber Breach
desc: A breach at Uber by the Lapsus$ group.

acts.d: Unknown malware was used to compromise the accounts/credentials of an external contractor
Attacker attempted to log in to the user's Uber VPN account but were blocked due to multi-factor authentication
Attackers repeatedly tried to use the user's credentials which caused MFA to spam the user requesting access to the VPN
Winthin the Uber environment, the user had access to a network share
Attackers discovered a PowerShell script containing hard-coded privileged accounts within the network share
Attackers used valid account credentials to access the PAM solution
Through PAM, attackers compromised access to systems using SSO and consoles, including the cloud management console
